_readme: The people tools/blender/make_people.py builds from MakeHuman (CC0). Each: MakeHuman targets (path under makehuman/data/targets, no extension) and their weights, mixed onto the base mesh; then fitted to our skeleton and body envelope. `outfit`: the garments he wears and their colours (tools/blender/clothes.py makes and drapes them, and bakes each a pixel texture). Output: assets/people/<id>.glb, <id>_<garment>.png, and <id>.json (what was done).

outlaw.note: A hard man in his late thirties: lean, wiry, a little weathered.
